integrity: The characteristic-three companion Jordan structure and orbit comparison are proved from explicit matrices; the full integer characteristic polynomials and modular fixed-space counts were separately checked. Computational tests are supplementary, and no independent review is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for the classical 33-vertex friendship/cospectral companion pair, finite fields of characteristic three, and the specified reversible linear update. The real-cospectral pair and friendship-side wave census are previous results; no claim about arbitrary cospectral graphs or other characteristics. An indexed-priority search is not a proof of absolute novelty.
title: Cospectral friendship twins have different characteristic-three wave orbit censuses
